prompt:
Create a new clean, final, high-resolution photographic plate for the same fictional cliffside hotel. Use the first attached image only as the style and framing reference: the same cutaway section of one floor set into a granite cliff, framed by a rough stone slab above and below, the same camera height, the same warm interior light against a dark night exterior, the same colour and photographic quality, and a slim vertical orange-glowing lift core near the right edge. Use the second and third attached images only as references for the room's contents.
The room is the hotel restaurant: set dining tables with white plates and dark upholstered chairs, pendant lights over the tables, an open kitchen counter with a softly lit back wall, and a window at the right onto misty blue mountains at dusk.
Ignore and do not reproduce any orange lines or dots in the references. Landscape 3:2.
No text, letters, numbers, logos, lines, dots or UI. No people.

inputs.role: edit input; style and framing reference

attempts.result: Usable landscape restaurant image; no retry.

observations: Inspected generated original with view_image at original detail, 1536 x 1024.
Landscape 3:2 restaurant framed by rough stone above and below, with set tables, dark upholstered chairs, pendant lights, kitchen counter, and a right-side mountain window. No people observed.
No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, or UI observed.
Visible lines: vertical orange-and-white lift light at right, pendant cords, window and door frames, panel and floor seams, stone cracks, and horizontal counter lighting.
Visible dots: recessed ceiling lights, small highlights, and small dark or bright door/panel fastener marks, including a horizontal row near the right lift panel.
No orange diagonal annotation lines or large orange annotation dots from the content reference observed.
